description: S-to-F tier lists for 208 product categories, built by consolidating independent research runs over expert reviews and owner reports. Every placement is cited, and every citation carries the outlet, a verbatim quote, who said it, and whether we fetched the link and confirmed it. Boards are graded both ways: the products the research says to avoid are published in the bottom tiers rather than dropped, so you get the half a buying guide leaves out. Products carry GTIN barcodes and, where the maker published one, an announcement date. No affiliate links and no sponsored placements: no brand can pay to move on a board.
